name: How long does a typical sewer repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sewer repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of sewer repair depends heavily on the severity and type of repair. Simple repairs like clearing a minor clog might take a few hours. More complex issues, such as trenchless pipe lining, can often be completed within one to three days. Traditional sewer line replacement involving excavation might take longer, ranging from a few days to a week, depending on site conditions and the length of the pipe. We will provide an estimated timeline after diagnosis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to several days for complex replacements, depending on the method and severity.
